title: french windows
medium: Rose Windows: Morphing video of 13th century French rose windows is fed through an algorithm where hue values are regenerated in real time on 8 channels. Functional clock hands appear when triggered by motion. Audio is also generative with 8 tracks being composed in real time. Photo, video animation, predicted lunar phases. Software on computer, size variable. Edition of 5 with 2 APs. 24-hour videos edition of 30, unique prints.
